notes: The verse opens with the preposition `לַ` and writes no conjunction, so the coordinating *And* is correctly `added` (rule 14's closing sentences), and it is kept apart from the supplied *it was told* because the two runs do different offices (rule 2).

The supplied *him* at t015 is defensible as `added` under rule 44 since no object morpheme stands with `יָּסֹבּוּ`; the note already names the competing rule 18 reading that would give both *him* pronouns to the one suffix on `לוֹ`.

*till morning light* is a construct chain rendered attributively (rule 28) with the rectum's article `unrepresented` for want of any written determiner (rule 29); the margin's alternative was read and set aside (rule 38).
